community_text:
[Rating: 1/10] I don't get it, the game designer also published an analysis about its optimal strategy. Are we supposed to recite that decision tree then play all games to draw...?  I mean, it's a fun thought process, but it's no longer a game in the same way tic-tac-toe is no longer a game.

[Rating: 1/10] Wow. Zero stars. Possibly the definitive "gotcha" game. After losing twice within fewer than 3 moves I decided to go do something else with my time

[Rating: 2/10] Nothing drives this game forward it's like an endless game of tic tac toe on a 5x5 board.  Someone moves, someone blocks, and repeat.

[Rating: 2/10] See my profile for my rating methodology. 3 - Poor. Likely won't play this again although could be convinced. 3 - Disparaging of this game  Too tactical to be interesting.

[Rating: 3/10] Nah, too minimalistic of an abstract game. Gives the same weird empty feeling after playing Tic Tac Toe for a while.

[Rating: 4/10] BGA: Probably the simplest abstract I know that isn't trivially solved. Maybe this one is too, and I just don't know the algorithm. I like it less as I play it more; It feels like I'm getting worse at it.

[Rating: 4.3/10] An Abstract for 2 players where each as 3 peaces of one color and the first to creat a line wins, just very basic.
